resources.string: Turn on to show the floating translate button over every app.
Screen capture inactive (asked on first use)
Every text on the screen is translated at once.
Only the text close to the button is translated. Park the button next to a sentence and long-press it — dragging only moves the button.
Translations disappear as soon as the page scrolls (recommended for feeds like Telegram).
Translations stay until you close the panel.
Installing a newer APK keeps your downloaded languages, models and settings. Only uninstalling the app removes them.
Download Persian (required) plus the languages you read, once while online.
All four green means you are ready to translate anything.
Download once while online, then translate fully offline. Each model is about 30 MB.
Complete these steps once. Tap each card to open its settings page.
Needed to show the floating button, the quick menu and the translation panel.
Required on Android 13 and newer so the translation services can run in the background.
Reads on-screen text instantly. Find “Dari Screen Translator” in the Accessibility settings and turn it on.
Asked automatically the first time an image or game needs translation. Choose “Entire screen”.
Toggle the big switch on the home screen.
A small floating button appears over every app. Drag it anywhere — after 3 idle seconds it docks to the edge and fades away until you touch it.
Tap it once to open the circular quick menu: Translate screen, Image (OCR), Auto on scroll, Close, and Turn off. The menu closes itself after you pick.
Long-press next to the text to translate just that part. A long-press also closes the menu and the translation panel — one button does everything.
Translations open in a panel at the bottom: the original text on top, the Dari translation below, fully scrollable and never cut off. Tap any translation to copy it.
With Auto on scroll enabled, the panel refreshes by itself after the page scrolls — no need to tap again.
Download language models in advance while you have internet.
Share the app with a friend through Zapya — models included (Settings → Share without internet). They install the app, then import the models file: full offline translation, zero internet.
Tap the floating button to open the quick menu.
Used only while translating images and games.
Reads on-screen text so it can be translated into Persian/Dari

This service reads the text of the current screen only when you tap the floating translate button, and passes it to the on-device translator. Password fields and text input fields are never read. Nothing leaves your phone.
No readable text found on this screen
No text near the button. Park it next to the text and long-press again
Nothing to translate (already Persian or unsupported)
Could not capture the screen. Try again
Allow screen capture to translate images
Screen capture was declined. Image translation is unavailable
Model for %1$s is missing. Open the app to download it
While the panel is open it refreshes by itself after the page scrolls — no need to tap again.
Google improves the language models over time. The app asks before downloading anything (recommended).
Model updates download silently, Wi-Fi only.
Never check for model updates. You can still check manually with the button below.
Language models are up to date
Model update failed. Check your connection
Google releases improved language models from time to time. Update now to keep translations accurate? Nothing downloads without your approval.
Send this app together with its downloaded language models to a friend through Zapya or SHAREit. Your friend installs the app, then imports the models — no internet needed on their side.
Received the models file? Pick it here to restore the models without internet.
Could not prepare the share files
No language models are downloaded yet — sharing the app only. Download models first to share them too.
%1$d model files restored — offline translation is ready
Could not read that file. Is it the models ZIP?
Connect to the internet once. The app downloads the Persian and English packs (about 35 MB) and after that it translates forever without internet.
Downloading the offline language packs… keep your internet on. This happens only once.
The download failed. Check your connection and try again.
This text is already in Persian/Dari — nothing to translate
Pashto → Dari is not supported offline yet (ML Kit has no Pashto model). Sorry!
No internet, and these language packs are not downloaded yet: %1$s. Connect once — after that it works offline forever.
Your data stays on your phone

Text reading, language detection and translation all run on this device — no ads, no analytics, no trackers. Screen text is never uploaded and no history is saved. Translations are hidden from screenshots and screen recordings. The only internet use is downloading language packs from Google, and only when you choose to. Password fields and typing boxes are never read.
Everything runs on-device (ML Kit bundled models)
Screen text is never uploaded; no history is kept
Translations are hidden from screenshots and recordings
Passwords and typing boxes are never read
Internet is used only to download language packs
